description: This Java class 'JsonCollectors' provides static utility methods that return Collector implementations for various JSON reduction operations, such as converting JSON fields or objects into JSON objects, arrays of keys or values, etc. It serves as a helper class for collecting JSON data structures.

classes.name: JsonCollectors
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for creating Collectors to process JSON data structures.

methods.name: fieldsToObject
methods.description: Returns a Collector that accumulates JSON fields into a JsonObject.

methods.name: objectsToObject
methods.description: Returns a Collector that accumulates JSON objects into a JsonObject.

methods.name: fieldKeysToArray
methods.description: Returns a Collector that accumulates the keys of JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: fieldValuesToArray
methods.description: Returns a Collector that accumulates the values of JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: valuesToArray
methods.description: Returns a Collector that accumulates JSON values into a JsonArray.
